current_capture_engine_config.profiler: torch (torch_npu text export, Level1, aic PipeUtilization)

representative_context.basis: profiled client input length; live context growth not observed

assumptions: Context basis: explicit_case_geometry; active KV increments during this capture are not established.
Forced load balance, acceptance=0.8/DSpark and prefix-hit=100% are not assumed to be captured facts.
Captured rank represents the declared balanced, exchange-symmetric cohort; this is conditional, not measured all-rank coverage.

observed.activity_interpretation: Union of non-scheduler event intervals, including real HCOM protocol wait; this is not PMU-confirmed useful hardware busy time.

batch_evidence.interpretation: Tensor-export execution batch may include graph padding; client concurrency is a request-level condition, not substituted for the captured execution batch.

comparison_assumptions: Context basis: explicit_case_geometry; active KV increments during this capture are not established.
Forced load balance, acceptance=0.8/DSpark and prefix-hit=100% are not assumed to be captured facts.

model_representation.basis: Sim parse_case result used by the public predictor

quant.name: fp8_dynamic+mxfp4_experts
notes: ordinary linears use FP8 weights with the declared block scales; routed experts use FP4 group32 with E8M0 scales
activation_scheme=dynamic is a kernel path, not a global model dtype

boundary_details.start: input hidden states and KV cache ready
boundary_details.end: target transformer body output ready on all cohort participants
boundary_details.speculation: tokens includes every target verification row; acceptance does not scale work
boundary_details.prefix_cache: context KV is ready; query rows still execute
boundary_details.deployment: first independent DP cohort; no request admission or capacity guarantee

scheduled_operator_summary.interpretation: These scheduled intervals can overlap and include contention or peer waits. They diagnose modeled latency; their sum is neither device service time nor a decomposition of body wall span.

prediction.interpretation: Body span is scheduler completion, not a sum of layer envelopes. Dense/MoE identifies the layer FFN; its attention remains attention. Embedding, final norm, LM head and MTP/draft are excluded, not zero-cost.

assumptions: Captured layer ordinal follows the declared full topology; this is not a Host occurrence binding.
One representative DP replica is compared under exchange symmetry; replicas are not summed.

steady_layer_comparison.quantile_scope: Each observed layer P50 uses all its Forward calls; the steady P50 is the median of those layer P50s, not a pooled quantile over all calls.

limitations: Graph execution envelopes and TPOT are not target-body spans.
Automatic topology alignment is not exact Host/module occurrence binding.
Scenario targets do not establish capture conditions.

Sim TP peers are symmetric and initially ready at zero; measured collective elapsed can include peer wait. Single-rank intervals cannot separate payload transport from peer wait and must not be used to fit link bandwidth.
